title: The Real Cookie Banner: GDPR & ePrivacy Cookie Consent plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site…
description: The Real Cookie Banner WordPress plugin up to version 5.4.2 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'comment' parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users access affected pages. Exploitation depends on the plugin being activated and prior approval of a comment from the same name and email, which triggers WordPress's auto-approval of subsequent comments from that identity.
